---
name: onboard-new-issue
description: Prepare a human-reviewed single-root issue change without silently expanding the benchmark.
---

# Reviewed issue changes

The fixed benchmark contains 36 issues. Adding an identity changes the reviewed inventory,
rotation and scoring coverage; do not silently append a case or renumber existing cases.
Agree on that scope before changing catalogs.

For a reviewed issue change, establish the healthy behavior, one independently fixable
root defect, activation scenario and independently observable endpoint/raw-span evidence.
Keep the validation mode reviewed data rather than fitting it to runtime outcomes.

The issue directory owns complete deployable source: a pure Prompt `definition.json` or
Hosted `source/` tree. Never implement runtime issue selectors, dormant alternate defects,
source patches or tool fixtures in Prompt traffic. Use canonical `traffic.json` attempts
and a matching `implementation.yaml`; avoid duplicate scenario authorities.

Exercise Hosted behavior through small local domain tests and the explicit real framework
suite with controlled external boundaries. Prompt runtime behavior is proven in staging.
Regenerate the two catalog views, run relevant offline checks, and use incremental staging
on the committed candidate. No digest chain, deployed paired-v0 or promotion ceremony.
Keep runtime evidence and model payloads private and preserve unchanged benchmark identities.
